throttled_429.action: Auto-retry with exponential backoff; lower concurrency if it persists for more than 2 hours.

network_timeout.action: Auto-retry; check agent host network if more than 1% of items time out.

permission_denied_source.action: Grant the migration service account read access at source, then retry.

path_too_long.action: Shorten folder names or remap the share root deeper, then re-run the folder pass.

target_quota.action: Raise storage allocation for the target shared drive or user, then retry.

item_too_large.action: Skipped by policy (over 25 MB per item); reported to the user in validation.

unsupported_type.action: Excluded by extension policy (.exe, .msi, .bat, .pst); kept read-only at source.

corrupt_item.action: Item corrupt at source; reported, no further retries.
